app.title: Show HN: Coldframe, a honeypot that poses as a supermarket fridge controller
app.description: A honeypot application that mimics a supermarket fridge controller to lure and log malicious traffic targeting IoT devices.
proposed_tests: Run the container and verify it accepts TCP connections on port 8080
Simulate a malicious client attempting to connect and ensure logs capture the interaction
Check that the honeypot serves the expected JSON API response for a healthy fridge
